result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the bottom navigation bar has a rendering defect: a dark horizontal bar overlaps the search and orders icons, obscuring them. Other minor observations relate to the second popular card lacking a visible title within the viewport, which is acceptable per the exclusions.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, a thick dark horizontal line/bar is drawn across the middle two icons (search and orders/receipt), partially covering them. This looks like a misplaced home indicator, progress bar, or active-tab underline rendered at the wrong position, making those tabs visually broken and hard to identify.
issues.suggestion: Remove or reposition the stray bar element (e.g., place the active indicator under the correct tab or move the system gesture indicator below the nav icons) so the search and orders icons are fully visible.

issues.description: Bottom navigation tabs have no text labels and only the home icon is highlighted; the obscured icons combined with no labels reduce clarity of what each tab does.
issues.suggestion: Add short text labels beneath each tab icon and ensure a consistent active-state indicator.
